title: Trap-Bar Deadlift
summary: A deadlift inside a hexagonal bar with neutral handles, which keeps you more upright and shares the work between the quads and hips.

setup.text: Stand in the centre of the bar and grip the handles.
Sit your hips down until your shoulders are over the handles, then brace.
Drive the floor away and stand tall.
Lower by pushing your hips back.

form_cues.cue: Brace and push through the floor
Stand up with hips and knees together
Use the high handles to start if your mobility is limited.

mistakes.text: Letting the hips rise before the bar moves.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
